definition: [ תָּעַע ] verb Pilpel, Hithpa`el mock (compare Arabic stammer , also shake violently ; onomatopoetic); — Pilpel Participle מְתַעְתֵּ֑עַ Gen 27:12 = substantive a mocker. Hithpa`el Participle plural מִתַּעְתְּעִים 2Chr 36:16 , with ב person, mocking at his prophets (+ מַלְעִבִים , בּוֺזִים ).

[תָּעַע] verb Pilpel, Hithpa`el mock (compare Arabic stammer, also shake violently; onomatopoetic); —

Pilpel Participle מְתַעְתֵּ֑עַ Gen 27:12 = substantive a mocker. Hithpa`el Participle plural מִתַּעְתְּעִים 2Chr 36:16, with ב person, mocking at his prophets (+מַלְעִבִים, בּוֺזִים).
